title: Glowing bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- soft glowing aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='46' ry='30' fill='#2a6f8f' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- bathtub body -->
  <path d='M12 52 h76 a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 v14 a14 14 0 0 1 -14 14 h-52 a14 14 0 0 1 -14 -14 v-14 a4 4 0 0 1 4 -4 z' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- tub rim highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='48' width='80' height='10' rx='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- rim lower shade for edge -->
  <rect x='12' y='55' width='76' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b8d8ea'/>
  <!-- water surface -->
  <rect x='20' y='50' width='60' height='9' rx='4' fill='#38d9f5'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='3' fill='#c8f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#e8ffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='55' r='3.2' fill='#c8f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#e8ffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glowing faucet -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='12' height='16' rx='3' fill='#9fb7c4'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d7e6ee'/>
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='20' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c9dbe6'/>
  <!-- spout glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='3' fill='#7de8ff'/>
  <rect x='48' y='43' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#7de8ff'/>
  <!-- faucet handles -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='5' fill='#8fa9b8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='5' fill='#8fa9b8'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#e6f4fa'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#e6f4fa'/>
  <!-- tub feet -->
  <rect x='22' y='84' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c9a86a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='84' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c9a86a'/>
  <!-- steam wisps -->
  <path d='M36 26 q-3 -6 0 -10 q3 -4 0 -8' stroke='#9fefff' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 22 q-3 -6 0 -10 q3 -4 0 -8' stroke='#9fefff' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 26 q-3 -6 0 -10 q3 -4 0 -8' stroke='#9fefff' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
